B66'10 answers on Q5' untick assumes Q5 still has its original 6 answers (mock harness)lowFixed in mock
Q5 returns to a consistent answer list.

Requirement. Q5 returns to a consistent answer list.

Reproduction on the mock. A) Filter Results + Rules, select Q5. Tick '10 answers on Q5', choose Five-point scale, untick. B) Choose Five-point on Q5 first, then tick and untick.

Root cause found in the mock. The cause is the `#stress` change handler at index.html:1035. On untick it runs `q.answers.length=6` and trims `r.conds.q5` to `i<6`. That assumes Q5 still has its 6 seeded answers plus the 4 EXTRA answers at indexes 6–9. But setPoints() (index.html:607-608) can shrink or grow Q5 between tick and untick. ACT.settype 'five' (:956) and ACT.tpts (:963) both call it. (A) If Q5 has fewer than 6 answers, setting length=6 grows the array and leaves an empty slot at index 5. typeMeta/isFive (:596, :600) and typeMenu (:615) read `.length`, which is 6. But pane() (:686, q.answers.map), sheets() (:768, forEach) and modalHTML() (:888, map) skip empty slots and draw 5 rows. setPoints then pushes new points after the slot. The JSON snapshot that Import uses (importFile before → impUndo :980) turns the slot into null, and the next render crashes on it. (B) If Q5 had 5 answers when ticked, EXTRA lands at indexes 5–8, so cutting to 6 keeps EXTRA[0] 'Ceramides for a stronger barrier' as point 6. On top of that, the tick pushes text answers onto a Five-point scale, so it becomes 'Scale · 1–9'.

Fixed in the mock by. Answers added by the '10 answers on Q5' tick carry a stress:true flag, which survives Import/Undo JSON copies. The untick removes exactly the flagged answers, never by setting .length, and re-indexes Q5 conditions in every rule, the draft and the pending Undo through a position map (eachRule). When Q5 is a scale, the tick tops it up to 10 numbered points instead of appending text answers. Rewrites the #stress change handler (~1060).

B67Unticking '30 recommendations' also deletes user-added recommendations that share an id (mock harness)lowFixed in mock
Only the recommendations the toggle added are removed; user-added vegan, fragrance-free and anti-aging (which share ids with EXTRA_RECS) sta…

Requirement. Only the recommendations the toggle added are removed; user-added vegan, fragrance-free and anti-aging (which share ids with EXTRA_RECS) stay.

Reproduction on the mock. Rules only: '+ Add recommendations' → Tags → vegan → Add. Create 'Show vegan when Q2 = Cheeks'. Tick, then untick '30 recommendations'.

Root cause found in the mock. The untick branch of the `#stress30` change handler (index.html:1055) removes recommendations by id, not by who added them. It builds `gone = new Set(EXTRA_RECS.map(r=>r.id))` and splices out every RECS entry whose id is in that set. It then strips those ids from every answer's `targets`, every rule's `recs`, `M.recs` and `S.armed`. The tick branch never adds an id that is already in RECS (`if(!RECS.some(x=>x.id===r.id))`). So when the user has already added vegan, fragrance-free or anti-aging, the toggle does not own that entry, but untick deletes it anyway and empties the rules and answers that use it. The code already marks the toggle's own entries: EXTRA_RECS items carry `extra:true` (line 1054), and the tick pushes `{...r}` copies that keep the flag. Entries the user adds through `arAdd` (line 1026-1027) are `{id,n,h,kind}` with no flag. Nothing reads the flag: the untick ignores it. A second problem makes it worse. In Rules only, `findings()` (about line 657) only blocks when there are no rules at all, so a rule emptied to recs=[] gets no warning and Continue stays enabled.

Fixed in the mock by. The '30 recommendations' untick removes only RECS entries flagged extra, and builds the set of removed ids from them. A recommendation the merchant added under the same name (vegan, fragrance-free, anti-aging) stays, along with its rules and mappings. The removed ids are stripped from answer targets, S.armed and, through eachRule, from rules, the draft and the pending Undo (~1085).

Glossary

Filter Results + Rules
Logic style 'attributes': one question picks a recommendation for each answer, other questions narrow by product values, and rules add exceptions. The live label was 'Attributes + Rules'.
Rules only
Logic style 'rules' (owner, 2026-09-21: a real engine mode, 100% its own method): every result comes from a rule; the first matching rule's recommendations are the result; question roles and answer mappings are ignored; shoppers no rule matches get the Results step's safety net.
logic_style
'rules' | 'attributes'. Today BuildSession.logic_style (draft-only, stripped at publish, quizSchema.ts:1698-1708); per D1 (decided 2026-09-21) it moves to a decider-gated optional doc field that publish keeps and the engine reads.
Recommendation
The merchant word for a Prisma Category row the quiz can show (code says bucket, target or category; never say 'bucket' in UI). Quiz rows have quizId set; custom groups are shop-global rows (quizId null) copied into the quiz as source 'group'.
Picks results (Picks the result)
Question role 'decides'. Exactly one per quiz (V1); each answer maps to one or more recommendations through Answer.target_id/target_ids.
Narrows (Narrows results)
Question role 'filter'. Each answer keeps products carrying chosen values (tags, metafields, variant options, product types, collections); OR within a question, AND across questions.
Info only
Role 'qualifier' or no role: the answer is collected but doesn't change results. Replaces 'Asked only'.
Keeps everything
Answer.no_preference: an explicit pass-through narrowing answer. Different from 'Select all', which still drops products carrying none of the values.
Rule
A DecisionRule: conditions [{question_id, answer_id, op}], optional any_of and match, action, target_id (+ target_ids). Array order is priority; the first matching rule wins and only one rule applies per shopper.
Show / Pin / Hide
Rule actions 'show' (today appends the rule's products after the pool), 'prioritize' (moves products already present to the front) and 'hide' (removes them). An action-less rule is the legacy replace and is never written by new UI. In Rules only the rule window offers Show alone (D2), because the first matching rule is the whole result and there is nothing to pin in front of or hide from; a stored Pin or Hide still renders in the lists and the file and the engine still resolves it.
is / is not
Condition op 'is' / 'is_not'. 'is not' means none of the listed answers was chosen; a skipped question satisfies it.
any of / all of
Within one question: any_of lists question ids whose 'is' answers need only one match; absent means every listed answer. Only multi-select questions can be 'all of'.
match any
DecisionRule.match 'any': an OR across questions. Only Paste rules writes it today; the new grammar is AND across questions (D13).
never runs
A rule an earlier rule always catches first (shadowed); computed by pathAnalyzer.shadowedRules and reported as V8. The live chip reads 'never fires'.
Coverage ('has a rule')
Whether at least one rule that can fire (has conditions and recommendations, not broken, not shadowed, not impossible) can put a recommendation in front of a shopper. The verb test is style-specific, because the engine is: in Filter Results + Rules there is a base pool, so only Show covers and Pin never does, and a recommendation placed on a Picks answer also counts; in Rules only there is no base, so anything but Hide covers. One helper, recommendationCoverage, answers it for every surface.
Tray, arm, place
The row of recommendation chips above the picking question's answers. Clicking a chip arms it (violet); clicking an answer cell places it once.
Strip
The 'Your recommendations' band under the rules in Rules only.
Rule window
The Create a rule / Edit rule dialog (CreateRuleModal).
Tier-1 report
buildTier1Report (pathReport.ts): deterministic checks V1–V16 and S1 with block, warn and info severities; the blocking count gates Continue and Publish.
Fix-N gate
The funnel CTA reading 'Fix N issue(s) to continue' when blocking > 0; still clickable, it opens the check popover.
Diagnose & preview (DiagnoseModal)
The live modal with Diagnostics (Tier-1 list plus the Tier-2 AI path-quality review) and Test a path (PathTester).
Decider doc / legacy doc
Quiz.logic_model 'decider' (the v2 engine) versus absent (the legacy points/ladder model, which must stay byte-identical).
build_session
Server-owned funnel scratch on the draft doc (stage, logic_style and more). The JSON autosave never writes it, and publish strips it.
G1 mirror
target_id always equals target_ids[0]; a one-item list is stored as target_id alone; read through answerTargets() and ruleTargets().
ensure-targets
POST /api/categories/ensure-targets: turns catalogue picks into quiz-scoped Category rows (at most 12 per call, idempotent, discoveryRunId 'logic-tab-<quizId>').
Autosave (useQuizDraft)
A 700 ms debounced whole-doc JSON PUT validated by Quiz.safeParse on the server; exposes isSaving, savedAt, saveError, retrySave and flushSave.
Field save pill
The small 'Saving… → ✓ Saved' pill at the end of an edited text after a committed change (decided Sep-18); there is no ambient save chip.
LogicTabCard
The shared Logic workspace component used by Step3Shell (funnel) and BuilderLogicView (main builder).
ruleFlow
A LogicTabCard/CreateRuleModal prop: 'onboarding' shows the 'Your recommendations' band; absent shows the builder's 'What the quiz shows' band.
Byte pin
After every deploy the sha256 of /q/cmqqcb0ao004mqvkwjug7t0ya.json must start with c02ccaec98a0fe9e.
Gate chain
npm run typecheck && npm test -- --run && npm run build && npm run lint && node scripts/check-tokens.mjs, run unpiped before any commit.
DS-V2 §7.5
The design-system toast rule in qz-toast.tsx: queue of one, 2.4 s, no actions. Amended 2026-09-22 (owner, D7): one optional action, a duration, a live region and keyboard reach. Record the dated exception beside the rule.
Stand-in
Mock-only data or behaviour that the real build replaces (section mock-stand-ins).
Newest-wins
The owner's precedence rule: the most recently dated ruling overrides older code comments and docs.
